# Plan: Open the universe to contributors

## Sources

`docs/game-design.md` "After the episode". `content/puzzles/service-panel.json` grants `flag:service-panel-open`. `artifactSchema` (`name`, `description`, `requires`, `links`) and `communitySchema` are in `src/content/schema.ts`. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/swarm-community.yml` is the SwarmOS intake form, so the new forms use the `swarm:community` label. `src/world/archive-view.ts` already prints `FILED BY`.

## In-game

- `content/artifacts/forge.json`: `requires: flag:service-panel-open`. Text is in-world: the network accepts new transmissions from Observers who sign their work, nothing is added without review, and filings go to a real address. `links`: prefilled `https://github.com/supernovae/signal-lost/issues/new?template=propose-transmission.yml` and `...propose-archive-entry.yml`, and the repository itself.
- `src/app/tools.ts`: one generic tool per available artifact, labelled with its `name`. It prints the description and opens `src/world/artifact-view.ts`, a panel of real links with `rel="noopener noreferrer"` and `target="_blank"`. Nothing fetches at runtime. No GitHub API calls, no token.
- A locked line: FORGE also says local write is denied, so it is partly accessible by design.
- `TRANSMISSIONS` prints `FILED BY: <author>` when a transmission has attribution, as the archive view does.
- `content/community/first-light.json`: a real community package with a transmission and an archive entry, unlocked by `flag:service-panel-open`, with attribution naming the project maintainers and `provenance` saying it ships as the example. No invented contributors.
- `content/characters/echo.json`: a reaction to reading the community archive entry (it was not written by anyone ECHO remembers), and a reaction to opening FORGE, recorded through a new `grantsOnOpen` field on artifacts (`flag:forge-opened`).
- `content/puzzles/service-panel.json`: the panel's success text now mentions power reaching the terminal, so FORGE's appearance has a cause.

## Repository

- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/propose-transmission.yml` and `propose-archive-entry.yml`: forms needing no code, using label `swarm:community`.
- `docs/content-authoring.md`: full worked example of adding a transmission (file path, JSON, unlocking, attribution, `npm run content:validate`, how to see it in game, PR). `docs/swarmos.md` is left for the release WorkUnit.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: ways to contribute with no code (issue forms), with code and no SwarmOS (fork and PR), and with SwarmOS (agent path, pointing at `AGENTS.md`).

## Tests

- `tests/unit/contribution.test.ts`:
  - extracts the worked example's fenced JSON from `docs/content-authoring.md`, writes it to a temporary copy of `content/` at the path the doc gives, runs `node scripts/validate-content.ts`, and asserts success and that the new id is in the loaded content;
  - asserts FORGE's issue links name form files that exist, and that the artifact is locked before the flag;
  - asserts no `token`/`ghp_` strings in `src` or `content` and no `api.github.com`;
  - asserts the community package is loaded with visible attribution data.
- `tests/e2e/forge.spec.ts`: FORGE is absent until the panel opens; opening it shows the links; the community entry shows `FILED BY`.

## Files

New: the above. Changed: `src/app/tools.ts`, `src/content/schema.ts`, `src/content/validate.ts`, `content/characters/echo.json`, `content/puzzles/service-panel.json`, `src/style.css`, `tests/unit/content.test.ts`.

## Out of scope

README, full docs set, and the roadmap (release WorkUnit). Automatic merging or a generated contribution history.
